---
title: "Steps Plot"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(showtext)

font_add_google('Quicksand', 'Quicksand')
showtext_auto()
```

## Load data

`global.R` holds the Google Sheets auth and wrangling; `get_data()` returns the processed data.

```{r load-data}
source('global.R')
data = get_data()
df_teams = data$df_teams
```

## Daily steps per team

```{r steps-plot}
# Team with the most steps overall gets highlighted
top_team = df_teams %>% group_by(Team) %>% summarise(total=sum(Steps)) %>% slice_max(total, n=1) %>% pull(Team)

plot_df = df_teams %>% mutate(is_top = Team == top_team)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x=Date, y=Steps, group=Team, color=is_top, alpha=is_top, linewidth=is_top)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('TRUE'='#4AE8B5', 'FALSE'='lightgray')) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values=c('TRUE'=1, 'FALSE'=0.5)) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values=c('TRUE'=1.5, 'FALSE'=1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
  labs(x='', y='Daily Steps') +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text=element_text(family='Quicksand'),
        axis.title=element_text(family='Quicksand'),
        plot.title=element_text(family='Quicksand'),
        legend.position='none')
```

## Daily steps per person

`data$df_people` only holds the top 12, so this uses the full long-format data (`data$df`).

```{r steps-plot-names}
df_names = data$df_people %>% filter(Person != 'aux')

top_name = df_names %>% group_by(Person) %>% summarise(total=sum(Steps, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% slice_max(total, n=1) %>% pull(Person)

names_df = df_names %>% mutate(is_top = Person == top_name)

ggplot(names_df, aes(x=Date, y=Steps, group=Person, color=is_top, alpha=is_top, linewidth=is_top)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('TRUE'='#4AE8B5', 'FALSE'='lightgray')) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values=c('TRUE'=1, 'FALSE'=0.5)) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values=c('TRUE'=1.5, 'FALSE'=0.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma) +
  labs(x='', y='Daily Steps') +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text=element_text(family='Quicksand'),
        axis.title=element_text(family='Quicksand'),
        legend.position='none')
```
